app_fee.value: No application fee is stated on IP Paris's PhD admissions pages or doctoral school internal regulations; applications are submitted online to thesis topics or via ADUM, and annual registration/CVEC fees apply upon enrolment.

fee_waiver.value: No PhD application fee or application-fee waiver is stated on the IP Paris doctoral pages checked.

gre_general.value: Neither IP Paris's PhD admissions pages nor the internal regulations of ED IP Paris and EDMH mention the GRE.

toefl_min.value: 90/120 minimum (or equivalent) required upon enrollment in the IP Paris Doctoral School (ED IP Paris, covering all IP Paris PhD disciplines except mathematics under co-accredited EDMH, which sets no score); conditional 1st-year enrollment is permitted with B2/C1 French while reaching the required English level in Year 1.
toefl_min.quote: To this end, doctoral students must provide proof of their level of English upon enrollment (minimum TOEFL score 90/120 or equivalent). Otherwise, they may be authorized to register subject to providing proof of proficiency in French (level B2/C1) during their 1st registration and reaching the required level in English during the 1st year of thesis.

ielts_min.value: ED IP Paris requires TOEFL 90/120 'or equivalent' at enrollment without specifying an IELTS band score (and EDMH states no score); the B2 IELTS/TOEFL/TOEIC requirement on the admissions page applies to the 5-year Bachelor-entry PhD Track.

english_waiver.value: The three-year PhD regulations of ED IP Paris and EDMH state no exemption rule for English-medium degrees or India (the native-speaker and English-taught program exemption on the admissions page applies to the 5-year PhD Track).

notes: IP Paris hosts two doctoral schools for the three-year PhD: the multidisciplinary IP Paris Doctoral School (ED IP Paris, covering 6 of 7 STEM PhD programs) and the co-accredited Hadamard Doctoral School of Mathematics (EDMH). ED IP Paris's internal regulations (validated March 13, 2024) require TOEFL 90/120 or equivalent upon enrollment (or conditional Year-1 registration with B2/C1 French), whereas EDMH's 2026 internal regulations (RI_EDMH_2026_vfinale.pdf) specify no English test threshold. The separate 5-year Bachelor-entry PhD Track requires B2 English (TOEIC, IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge ESOL) with an MOI/native-speaker waiver.
